digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command dispatch
propositions: Advanced command grammars must be extracted into lean, reusable argparse factory functions that do not import optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing).

Parser construction must raise ParseError instead of SystemExit(2); all handlers that catch SystemExit during parse failures must be updated to also catch ParseError and preserve identical exit codes and stderr output.

Migrated parser factories must support optional presentation parameters (usage, add_help, formatter_class) to preserve byte-identical --help output for commands with custom formatting or disabled help.

All registered advanced command routes must resolve to valid factory references and construct parsers deterministically without executing handlers, proving S2d generation-readiness in a no-extras environment.
Nested command selection, argument acceptance/rejection, diagnostics, streams, exit codes, and lean-mode behavior must remain unchanged from current production paths through the migration.
